summary:
Held 0 of today's 10 biggest US movers.

• 6 upside misses — TRGP +4%, FANG +4%, KMI +4%, APA +4%, NOC +4%. These cleared the universe screen but no strategy picked them up; the morning brief either filtered them on a catalyst/RSI/earnings rule or had nothing positive to trigger an entry.

• 4 downside moves (TWLO -11%, SMCI -10%, FLEX -8%, MRNA -8%) are unreachable on a long-only basket — no mechanism to express a short or pair-trade.

• Most instructive miss: TWLO (-10.62%) — No company-specific news. TWLO fell about 10.6% to 244.37 in a sector-wide software/AI selloff, with valuation and AI-disruption worries and an HSBC Reduce call in the background. Q3 earnings are due Oct 29. Why we passed: Outside any active strategy's universe: TWLO is a mid-cap software name that no strategy lists. The move was a one-day sector-wide gap-down with no stock-specific catalyst, so a long-only momentum or news-reactive bot would not have a long entry.
